from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query all hourly air quality data for October 5, 2025 with station info
query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.id as station_id,
    aqs.name_en as station_name,
    aqs.station_type,
    hsaq.datetime,
    hsaq.o3,
    hsaq.no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.o3 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY aqs.id, hsaq.datetime
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total records: {len(df)}")
print(f"Stations: {df['station_name'].unique()}")
print(f"Station types: {df['station_type'].unique()}")
print(df.head(10))

# Calculate photochemical oxidant partitioning ratio: O3/(O3 + NO2)
df['ox_ratio'] = df['o3'] / (df['o3'] + df['no2'])

# Calculate daily average ratio per station
daily_avg = df.groupby(['station_id', 'station_name', 'station_type']).agg(
    mean_ratio=('ox_ratio', 'mean'),
    count_hours=('ox_ratio', 'count')
).reset_index()

print("\nDaily average ratios per station:")
print(daily_avg.sort_values('mean_ratio', ascending=False))

# Mean ratio for roadside vs general stations
roadside_mean = daily_avg[daily_avg['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE']['mean_ratio'].mean()
general_mean = daily_avg[daily_avg['station_type'] == 'GENERAL']['mean_ratio'].mean()

print(f"\nMean ratio for ROADSIDE stations: {roadside_mean:.3f}")
print(f"Mean ratio for GENERAL stations: {general_mean:.3f}")

# Station with highest ratio
highest_station = daily_avg.loc[daily_avg['mean_ratio'].idxmax()]
print(f"\nHighest ratio station: {highest_station['station_name']}")
print(f"Highest ratio: {highest_station['mean_ratio']:.3f}")

# Store results
roadside_ox_ratio = round(float(roadside_mean), 3)
general_ox_ratio = round(float(general_mean), 3)
highest_ox_station = highest_station['station_name']
highest_ox_ratio = round(float(highest_station['mean_ratio']), 3)

print(f"\n=== RESULTS ===")
print(f"roadside_ox_ratio: {roadside_ox_ratio}")
print(f"general_ox_ratio: {general_ox_ratio}")
print(f"highest_ox_station: {highest_ox_station}")
print(f"highest_ox_ratio: {highest_ox_ratio}")

# Now compute time-window specific ratios for Tap Mun (highest ratio station, station_id=8)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    hsaq.datetime,
    hsaq.o3,
    hsaq.no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
WHERE hsaq.station_id = 8
  AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.o3 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
""")

df_tapmun = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
df_tapmun['ox_ratio'] = df_tapmun['o3'] / (df_tapmun['o3'] + df_tapmun['no2'])
df_tapmun['hour'] = df_tapmun['datetime'].dt.hour

# Morning: 06:00-09:00 (inclusive of 06, 07, 08, exclusive of 09 based on convention)
# Actually, per time-window conventions: "06:00 to 09:00" means start-inclusive, end-exclusive
# So hours 6, 7, 8
morning_mask = (df_tapmun['hour'] >= 6) & (df_tapmun['hour'] < 9)
morning_ox = round(float(df_tapmun[morning_mask]['ox_ratio'].mean()), 3)

# Midday: 11:00-14:00 (hours 11, 12, 13)
midday_mask = (df_tapmun['hour'] >= 11) & (df_tapmun['hour'] < 14)
midday_ox = round(float(df_tapmun[midday_mask]['ox_ratio'].mean()), 3)

# Evening: 17:00-20:00 (hours 17, 18, 19)
evening_mask = (df_tapmun['hour'] >= 17) & (df_tapmun['hour'] < 20)
evening_ox = round(float(df_tapmun[evening_mask]['ox_ratio'].mean()), 3)

print(f"Morning (06-09) ox ratio at Tap Mun: {morning_ox}")
print(f"Midday (11-14) ox ratio at Tap Mun: {midday_ox}")
print(f"Evening (17-20) ox ratio at Tap Mun: {evening_ox}")

# Store final results
morning_ox = morning_ox
midday_ox = midday_ox
evening_ox = evening_ox

print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
print(f"roadside_ox_ratio: {roadside_ox_ratio}")
print(f"general_ox_ratio: {general_ox_ratio}")
print(f"highest_ox_station: {highest_ox_station}")
print(f"highest_ox_ratio: {highest_ox_ratio}")
print(f"morning_ox: {morning_ox}")
print(f"midday_ox: {midday_ox}")
print(f"evening_ox: {evening_ox}")
